sentences.text: The Blue Dog Coalition , commonly known as the Blue Dogs or Blue Dog Democrats , is a caucus of United States Congressional Representatives from the Democratic Party who identify as conservative Democrats .	Democratic Party	Democratic Party (United States)	caucus	Congressional caucus

It was formed in 1995 during the 104th Congress to give more conservative members from the Democratic party a unified voice after the Democrats ' loss of Congress in the U.S. Congressional election of 1994 .	104th Congress	104th United States Congress	U.S. Congressional election of 1994	United States House of Representatives elections, 1994
Blue Dog Coalition membership experienced a rapid decline in the 2010s , holding 14 seats in the 114th Congress .	114th Congress	114th Congress
The 115th Congress has seen the Coalition grow to 18 members .	115th Congress	115th Congress

causal_questions.question: Liberal Socialists were the only people to form The Blue Dog Coalition.
